components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ink outline for secondary and destructive actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--color-ink, #222222); border-radius: 8px; background: #ffffff; color: var(--color-ink, #222222); font-family: var(--font-body, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, transform 0.1s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-surface-subtle, #f7f7f7); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink, #222222); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Hairline field with a doubled ink border on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-field-label { font-family: var(--font-body, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-ink, #222222); } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #dddddd); border-radius: 8px; background: #ffffff; color: var(--color-ink, #222222); font-family: var(--font-body, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 1rem; caret-color: var(--color-brand, #3451d1); outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6a6a6a; } .ds-input:hover:not(:focus) { border-color: #b0b0b0; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--color-ink, #222222); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--color-ink, #222222); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Full pill toggle; Sky Tint with an Iris border when selected.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #dddddd); border-radius: 999px; background: #ffffff; color: var(--color-ink, #222222); font-family: var(--font-body, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--color-ink, #222222); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--color-brand-tint, #eaefff); border-color: var(--color-brand, #3451d1); color: var(--color-brand-deep, #1f2f86); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink, #222222); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-select { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; max-width: 320px; font-family: var(--font-body, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-select-label { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-ink, #222222); } .ds-select-trigger { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--color-ink, #222222); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--color-ink, #222222); border-radius: 8px; background: #ffffff; color: var(--color-ink, #222222); font: inherit; font-size: 1rem; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-select-trigger span { flex: 1; } .ds-select-chevron { transform: rotate(180deg); } .ds-select-list { margin: 2px 0 0; padding: 6px; list-style: none; background: #ffffff; border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: rgba(0,0,0,0.02) 0 0 0 1px, rgba(0,0,0,0.04) 0 2px 6px 0, rgba(0,0,0,0.1) 0 4px 8px 0; } .ds-select-option { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: var(--color-ink, #222222); cursor: pointer; } .ds-select-option.is-active { background: var(--color-surface-subtle, #f7f7f7); } .ds-select-option[aria-selected="true"] { font-weight: 600; }

components.css: .ds-listing { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; width: 260px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 20px; color: var(--color-ink, #222222); font-family: var(--font-body, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-listing:hover, .ds-listing:focus-visible { box-shadow: rgba(0,0,0,0.02) 0 0 0 1px, rgba(0,0,0,0.04) 0 2px 6px 0, rgba(0,0,0,0.1) 0 4px 8px 0; transform: translateY(-2px); outline: none; } .ds-listing-photo { position: relative; display: block; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; margin-bottom: 10px; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--color-brand-tint, #eaefff); } .ds-photo-pill { position: absolute; top: 12px; left: 12px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: #ffffff; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-listing-name { font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-listing-meta { font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.35; color: #6a6a6a; } .ds-listing-rate { margin-top: 4px; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-listing-rate strong { font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Dot plus label; only Live is Iris and pulses.
components.html: LiveFilledOpenExpired
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: var(--font-body, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-ink, #222222); } .ds-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-ink, #222222); } .ds-live .ds-dot { background: var(--color-brand, #3451d1); animation: ds-pulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-pending .ds-dot { background: transparent; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px #6a6a6a; } .ds-ended { color: #6a6a6a; } .ds-ended .ds-dot { background: #c1c1c1; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.35; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-live .ds-dot { animation: none; } }

components.css: .ds-countdown { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; font-family: var(--font-body, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-cd-dots { display: flex; gap: 5px; } .ds-cd { display: block; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-border, #dddddd); } .ds-left, .ds-current { background: var(--color-brand, #3451d1); } .ds-current { animation: ds-cd-pulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-cd-value { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-ink, #222222); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } @keyframes ds-cd-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.35; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-current { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
Blink borrows the grammar of a mature listings marketplace and applies it to optometry shifts. Shifts read like listings: a storefront photo, the clinic name, the role, the day and the rate. Search comes first and sits in a wide pill. The canvas is white, the text is near-black ink, and one blue, Iris, does every job that needs colour. A pale Sky tint carries the large quiet areas. Everything else is hairlines, soft grey surfaces and type.

Density changes with the mode. Public pages breathe, with a centred display headline and generous vertical space. App screens (shift search, negotiation, admin tables) are tighter and more precise: hairline rows, sticky table headers, tabular figures and quiet underline tabs. Motion is rare and named: the logo blinks, the hero's eyelid band flattens on scroll, the live dot pulses, and a confirmed match plays one blink. Pages do not animate in. Two small signatures carry the eye-care theme: a family of eight line illustrations, and eye-chart lettering in Optician Sans on a few quiet surfaces.

The brand mark is a two-lid eye. The upper lid is ink, the lower lid is Iris with three short lashes, and the lowercase "blink" wordmark sits beside it in the display face. The product rejects the gradient hero with stock icon cards, a clinical white-and-blue hospital look, playful styling and a dark technical look.
keyCharacteristics: One accent, Iris, on a white and ink base, with a pale Sky tint for large areas.
Photo-led listing cards with one fixed illustrative storefront photo per clinic.
Schibsted Grotesk headlines, Inter interface text, tabular figures for money and times.
8px controls, 14px cards, full pills for search, chips and map markers.
One soft shadow tier, used only for lift: search, hovered cards, menus, select lists and map markers.
Statuses are a dot and a label, never a coloured pill.
Eight spot illustrations in ink with one Iris detail, on the logo's 3px round stroke.
Optician Sans, the eye-chart face, only on the 404 page, zero-result charts, the admin review badge and the footer.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Iris is the only accent; Sky is its tint, not a second colour. If a new element needs emphasis and is not a primary action, a live state or a selected state, it gets ink or weight, not a colour.

rules.name: The Live Is Iris Rule
rules.body: Among statuses, only Live is Iris, and it pulses. Filled and Approved use a solid ink dot, Open and In review use a hollow grey ring, Ended states use a grey dot.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Rates, times, counts and the countdown use tabular figures (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`), so columns and live numbers do not jitter.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: No text in the product is uppercase or letter-spaced for decoration. Small labels name a field; they never sit above a heading as a tag.

rules.name: The One Tier Rule
rules.body: There is one shadow. A hovered listing card gets the tier and rises 2px; nothing gets a second, heavier shadow.

rules.name: The Four Places Rule
rules.body: Optician Sans appears in four places only: the 404 page, zero-result search states (filtered shift search and clinic search), the admin credential review badge and the footer sign-off. It never sets working content such as rates, names or headings.

dos: Do use Iris (#3451d1) only for primary actions, live and selected states, form-control fills, clinic map pins, the illustration details and the logo's lower lid.
Do keep Optician Sans to its four places, always decorative and hidden from screen readers.
Do show every status as an 8px dot plus a sentence-case label.
Do set rates, times and counts in tabular figures.
Do use 8px corners for controls, 14px for cards and photos, and full pills for search, chips and map markers.
Do keep surfaces flat at rest and use the one shadow tier for lift.
Do lead listings with the clinic's fixed photo and keep the "Illustrative photo" note.
Do honour reduced motion: the logo, the eyelid band and the pulses all stop.
donts: Don't add a second accent colour or colour-coded status pills. Sky is a tint of Iris, not a second accent.
Don't make any status other than Live Iris.
Don't show a large ticking countdown number; the 15 dots carry the time.
Don't add a second, heavier shadow.
Don't use a gradient hero, stock icon feature cards, a white-and-blue clinical look, playful styling or a dark technical theme.
Don't put uppercase or letter-spaced tags above headings.
Don't colour destructive buttons red; confirm the action in context instead.
Don't put a faint eye chart behind the home hero.
